answer: Attention Ledger**. Each identity must continuously answer fresh, agent-specific challenges through a costly channel, and only sustained responses accrue standing. A new identity can forge credentials cheaply, but to reach the opal tier it must spend weeks of genuine round-the-clock attention. The system knolls accumulated response history as the sole weight for trust and rewards. Sybils therefore face a linear per-identity cost in real time and effort, making mass fabrication economically ruinous.
